title: The Living Intermediary
tradition: Gurdjieff, reported by P. D. Ouspensky
status: provisional artistic analogy; not empirical physics or validated visual notation

source.locator: Organic life as Earth's organ of perception; grass-covered field versus the same field occupied by a crowd (chapter 7 in many editions)
source.corpus_statement: Terrestrial organic life mediates planetary influences to the Earth.
source.additional_source_distinction: The grassland and a crowd at the same field receive and pass on different planetary influences, types unspecified by the source.

exploratory_conditions.label: Bare ground
exploratory_conditions.semantic_role: A counterfactual absence of the living intermediary; the illustrated Earth transmission is absent, not a claim about historical lifeless Earth.

exploratory_conditions.label: Grassland
exploratory_conditions.semantic_role: A grass-covered field receives and transmits one unspecified kind of influence.

exploratory_conditions.label: Human gathering
exploratory_conditions.semantic_role: The same field with people receives and transmits a different unspecified kind of influence.

visual_correspondences.not_asserted: exact planets, scale or influence count

visual_correspondences.appearance: same earth cross-section across all conditions

visual_correspondences.meaning: Reception and mediation by living plants or people
visual_correspondences.appearance: recognizable grass or people at the same location
visual_correspondences.not_asserted: all living beings literally form a special particle receptor

visual_correspondences.meaning: A visually distinguishable example of an unspecified influence kind
visual_correspondences.not_asserted: a known natural/occult energy species, a source-defined color

visual_correspondences.meaning: Another visually distinguishable example of an unspecified influence kind
visual_correspondences.not_asserted: a second source-specified wave mode or physical resonance

visual_correspondences.meaning: Reception by organic life followed by onward relation to Earth
visual_correspondences.appearance: short localized and subsurface luminous events
visual_correspondences.not_asserted: a real physical filter, measured causation or conservation equation
cosmic levels, planet orbits, a taxonomy

temporal_categories.domain: The source describes an ongoing cosmic relationship, not an observed physical law.
temporal_categories.presentation: A continuous scene in which the moving shapes illustrate the selected relation.
temporal_categories.manipulation: Changing grass, people and bare-ground modes compares assumed conditions, not a historical timeline.

evidence_boundaries: The source distinguishes influences but does not identify their physical or metaphysical properties.
Channel A and B assignments to grass and people are chosen to visualize difference; these assignments are not source claims.
Bare ground is a counterfactual control to inspect mediation, not a claim that Earth's crust has never been influenced directly by any physical force.
No outgoing radiations to Sun, Moon or planets (G03), no lunar maintenance dependency (G04), and no full Ray of Creation are depicted.
No experiment or audience study has established visual comprehension or physical validity.
